findings.issue: Common noun נֶגֶב is Hebraized as the regional name Neguev, closing the directional sense the lemma and morphology leave open.
מִחוּץ לָעִיר is outside the city; «a la ciudad» can be read as motion toward the city.

notes: 2mp medirán is ustedes address; the four measures, singular codo, and plural ejidos follow the tokens.
